purpose: Define a loss-aware, read-only mapping contract for Mycelix SAP, TEND and MYCEL into ValueFlows-shaped economic facts. This is not a production adapter or an authoritative ledger implementation.

source_profile.version_note: Keep the published ValueFlows ontology version and the hREA source branch's stated VF 1.0 profile as distinct facts. This fixture does not claim full normative conformance or binary/DNA compatibility.

mapping_contract.quantity_policy: Authoritative numeric quantities are emitted as canonical base-10 integer strings in the mapping envelope, not binary floating-point JSON numbers. A downstream serializer may emit a ValueFlows Measure only when its exact-decimal behavior is established; the original integer string and unit profile remain available for round-trip checks.
mapping_contract.identity_policy: Every external identifier is namespaced by source system and scope. Equal bare IDs from different sources are not the same resource unless an explicit, evidence-bound crosswalk exists.
mapping_contract.correction_policy: Corrections append a new record referencing the corrected event. They do not mutate or erase the historical source event.
mapping_contract.semantics_policy: Economic facts, reputation attestations, eligibility, authorization, settlement and outcomes remain separate claim types.

mappings.notes: Candidate export representation only. An EconomicEvent describing transfer is not authorization to mutate an SAP balance or proof of external settlement.

The current TendExchange.hours and cumulative hours fields are f32. Export of an authoritative numeric TEND quantity is blocked until a versioned quantization/precision profile, error bound and round-trip test are defined. Do not imply the source float is an exact decimal. TEND is a community-scoped mutual-credit position arising from a service exchange, not an assumed bearer token that can be detached from its community/counterparty obligations.
Represent recognition as an attributable, scoped claim/attestation. Do not project MYCEL into a transferable quantity, currency, or authoritative global reputation score.

negative_controls.input_condition: Imported EconomicEvent is used directly to increase, decrease, or settle an authoritative Mycelix SAP/TEND balance.
MYCEL recognition is exported as currency, transferable balance, or spendable entitlement.
TEND obligation is translated into SAP without an explicit, separately authorized exchange event and conversion profile.
An authoritative SAP micro-unit amount is parsed through binary floating point or loses its base-10 integer representation.
A quantity lacks its unit profile or a receiving adapter substitutes another unit.
Community/issuer scope is omitted and records from separate economic networks become indistinguishable.
An exported record loses its source system, source record, source action/event, or revision identity.
The same imported observation is replayed and counted as a second economic effect.
A correction overwrites the original event or removes its provenance from historical exports.
Stale, missing, conflicting or unsupported evidence is represented as settled, valid, or definitively false without a policy basis.
hREA source's stated VF 1.0 profile is silently treated as identical to the published ontology page version 0.17, or a source branch is treated as a packaged compatible artifact.
TEND service hours sourced from the legacy f32 fields are exported as an exact decimal quantity without a versioned quantization/precision profile.
A TEND balance/obligation is exported as freely transferable bearer units without the original community, counterparties and service-obligation scope.
